description: Privately set within a gated Tarzana community, this beautifully updated 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath townhome offers the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and everyday convenience. Recently renovated and filled with natural light, the home features an open concept layout that seamlessly connects the living, dining, kitchen, and outdoor spaces, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The kitchen is well appointed with ample cabinetry, generous storage, and dual sinks, complemented by a thoughtfully integrated in unit laundry area that enhances both flow and practicality. All bedrooms are situated upstairs, including a spacious primary suite with ample closet space and a large bathroom complete with a soaking tub, while two additional bedrooms offer great natural light and share a well sized bathroom, creating a well balanced and functional layout. The large private patio is perfect for outdoor dining or lounging, with direct access to your own private 2 car garage. The community is beautifully maintained and offers a pool, clubhouse, expansive grassy areas, and manicured grounds. Conveniently located with easy access to the 101 freeway, Ventura Boulevard, and Providence Cedars-Sinai Tarzana Medical Center, along with a wide variety of grocery stores, restaurants, and boutique shopping, this is a turnkey opportunity in one of Tarzana’s most desirable settings.
